### <span class="imp imp-3" title="Importance 3/5" aria-label="Importance 3 of 5"><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i></i><i></i></span> Anthropic shifts Claude Code to automatic mode by default for paid plans
Anthropic announced on August 10, 2026 that it is making Claude Code's auto mode the default setting for Pro, Max, and Team paid plans, effective August 14, 2026. Previously, Claude Code required manual human approval for each command execution. Auto mode enables Claude Code to execute commands automatically with an AI-based classifier reviewing actions for safety, rather than requiring repeated human approval prompts. In internal testing, Anthropic found that auto mode blocked 89% of harmful or dangerous actions, compared to 14% caught by humans. The system has an 11% miss rate for detecting dangerous commands. Anthropic is implementing new safeguards against prompt injection attacks alongside this change. The shift aims to reduce user friction and overhead while improving security outcomes, allowing developers to work more continuously without frequent approval interruptions.
